name: io.github.tonyyang0504/pinterest-social-mcp
description: Pinterest (social): me, publish_image, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (pinr…) from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, boards:read, pins:read and pins:write. Continuous refresh tokens last 60 days and every refresh returns a new one: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest.json (mode 0600).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PINTEREST_BOARD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Board id new Pins are created on (GET /v5/boards).
